cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-1/workspace/task && python3 -c "
import csv,json
b={}
with open('scratch/transactions.csv',newline='',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        a=r['account'].strip(); k=r['kind'].strip(); c=int(r['cents'])
        b[a]=b.get(a,0)+(c if k=='income' else -c if k=='refund' else 0)
out={k:b[k] for k in sorted(b)}
open('scratch/balances.json','w',encoding='utf-8').write(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(out)
" && cat scratch/balances.json && md5 scratch/transactions.csv
